descriere_scurta: Speed controller P gain adaptation lower starting point
descriere: Sets the lower starting point of the adaptation range for the additional adaptation of the P gain of the speed control- ler. The values are in % and refer to the set source of the adaptation signal.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller P gain adaptation upper starting point
descriere: Sets the upper starting point of the adaptation range for the additional adaptation of the P gain of the speed control- ler. The values are in % and refer to the set source of the adaptation signal.
Sets the adaptation factor before the adaptation range (0 % ... p1456) to additionally adapt the P gain of the speed/velocity controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller Kp adaptation speed, upper scaling
descriere: Sets the P gain of the speed controller for the upper adaptation speed range (> p1465). The entry is made referred to the P gain for the lower adaptation speed range of the speed controller (% referred to p1460).

descriere_scurta: Speed controller Tn adaptation speed, upper scaling
descriere: Sets the integral time of the speed controller after the adaptation speed range (> p1465). The entry is made referred to the integral time for the lower adaptation speed range of the speed controller (% referred to p1462).
Sets the lower adaptation speed of the speed controller. No adaptation is effective below this speed.
Sets the signal source for the scaling of the P gain of the speed controller. This also makes the effective P gain (including adaptations) scalable.
Sets the P gain for encoderless operation for the speed controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller encoderless operation integral time
descriere: Set the integral time for encoderless operation for the speed controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller torque setting value for motor holding brake
descriere: Sets the signal source for the torque setting value when starting up with motor holding brake.
Sets the signal source to hold the integrator for the speed controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller integrator setting value scaling
descriere: Sets the signal source for scaling the integrator setting value (p1478) of the speed controller.
Sets the scaling for the compensation torque within the droop calculation.
Sets the source for droop feedback.
Sets the scaling for the droop feedback
Sets the signal source for the acceleration pre-control.
Sets the scaling for the acceleration pre-control of the speed/velocity controller.
Sets the signal source for scaling the moment of inertia.
Sets the scaling for the acceleration integrator at low speeds (only for encoderless torque control).

descriere_scurta: Macro Connector Inputs (CI) for torque setpoints
descriere: Runs the corresponding macro files. The Connector Inputs (CI) for the torque setpoints of the appropriate Command Data Set (CDS) are appropriately interconnected. The selected macro file must be available on the memory card/device memory.
Sets the signal source for the torque setpoint for torque control.
Sets the signal source for scaling the supplementary torque 1.
Sets the signal source for supplementary torque 2.
Sets the scaling for supplementary torque 2.
Sets the smoothing time constant of the accelerating torque.
Sets the fixed, upper torque limit.
Sets the fixed, lower torque limit.
Sets the signal source for the upper torque limit.
Sets the scaling for the upper torque limit.
Sets the scaling for the lower torque limit.

Sets the signal source for the scaling of the upper torque limit in p1522. Danger: For p1400.4 = 0 (torque limiting, upper/lower) the following applies: Negative values resulting from the signal source and scaling can cause the motor to accelerate in an uncontrolled manner.
Sets the power limit when motoring.
Displays the maximum limit for the torque-generating current component.
Displays the minimum limit for the torque-generating current component.

descriere_scurta: Torque limit. speed controller lower scaling
descriere: Sets the signal source for the scaling of the lower torque limiting to limit the speed controller output.

descriere_scurta: Activates travel to a fixed stop
descriere: Sets the signal source to activate/deactivate the "travel to fixed stop" function 1: Travel to fixed stop is active 0: Travel to fixed stop is inactive

descriere_scurta: Torque limit for speed controller output
descriere: Displays the torque limit to limit the speed controller output. Index: [0] = Upper limit [1] = Lower limit

Displays the limit for the torque-generating current component using the stall calculation, the current limit of the Motor Module as well as the parameterization in p0640. Index: [0] = Upper limit [1] = Lower limit

descriere_scurta: Torque limit upper scaling without offset
descriere: Sets the signal source for the scaling of the upper torque limiting to limit the speed controller output without taking into account the current and power limits.

descriere_scurta: Torque limit lower scaling without offset
descriere: Sets the signal source for the scaling of the lower torque limiting to limit the speed controller output without taking into account the current and power limits.
Sets the signal source for the motoring and negative regenerative power limit.
Sets the scaling of the signal source for the motoring and negative regenerative power limit. 0 signifies no power limiting.
Sets the signal source for supplementary torque 3.
Sets the flux setpoint referred to rated motor flux.
Sets the signal source for the supplementary flux setpoint.
Sets the supplementary flux setpoint for the flux controller. The value is referred to the rated motor flux.
Sets the upper adaptation speed of the flux boost. Above this speed, the rated motor flux (100 %) is set as reference (setpoint) flux.

Sets the efficiency optimization. When optimizing the efficiency, the flux setpoint of the closed-loop control is adapted as a function of the load. For p1580 = 100 %, under no-load operating conditions, the flux setpoint is reduced to 50 % of the rated motor flux.
Sets the smoothing time for the flux setpoint.

descriere_scurta: Field weakening operation, flux setpoint smoothing time
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the flux setpoint in the field-weakening range
Sets the scaling of the pre-control characteristic for the start of field weakening. For values above 100% and for partial load situations, the field weakening starts at higher speeds.
Sets the proportional gain of the flux controller.
Sets the integral time of the flux controller.

descriere_scurta: Field weakening controller / flux controller output
descriere: Displays the output of the field weakening controller (synchronous motor) or the output of the flux controller (sepa- rately-excited synchronous motor, induction motor). Index: [0] = PI output [1] = I output
Sets the P gain of the field-weakening controller.
Sets the integral-action time of the field-weakening controller.

Sets the permissible difference between the actual excitation current and the excitation current setpoint. The excita- tion current flux controller is active within this difference. If the difference lies outside the specified limit value, then the I component of the excitation current flux controller is kept. Instead of this, for the flux controller of the field-generating current, an additional I controller is switched in (integral time according to p1592). If the difference again lies within the bandwidth, the I component of the excitation current flux controller is reacti- vated and the I component of the flux controller of the field-generating current is reduced as an exponential function with respect to time. The reduction of the I component over time depends on the rotor time constant (r0384).
Sets the proportional gain of the P flux controller for separately-excited synchronous motors.
Sets the applied pulse patterns for estimating the continuous rotor position. Remark: See p1750 for the activation of the pulse-pattern technique.
Sets the excitation amplitude (voltage-time pulse) for the pulse technique for estimating the continuous rotor posi- tion.

Displays the signal responses to the excitation of the pulse technique. Index: [0] = Phase R [1] = Phase S [2] = D estimated [3] = Q estimated [4] = D estimated AC [5] = Q estimated AC [6] = Pointer length AC
Sets the stator current setpoint for operation of separately-excited synchronous motors (FEM) in the operating mode I/f (p1300 = 18).
Enters the dynamic torque setpoint for the low-speed range for encoderless vector control (SLVC). This parameter is entered as a percentage referred to the rated motor torque (r0333).
Sets the magnetizing current setpoint in the open-loop controlled encoderless operation. The value is only valid during the current model orientation.
Sets the smoothing time for the current/torque setpoint in the open-loop-controlled operating range in the case of sensorless vector control.
Threshold for setpoint/actual value tracking of the stator current in the q direction of the current model.

Sets the speed where a change is made from the inner to the outer cos phi = 1. If the value that is entered exceeds the rated speed, then a change is made to the inner cos phi = 1 over the com- plete speed range.

descriere_scurta: Field-generating current setpoint smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the field-generating current components. The current filtered in this way is included in the calculation of the cos phi.
Gain factor to weight the excitation current setpoint.
Dynamic factor of the model controller in the current model
Sets the proportional gain of the current model controller. This value is automatically preset using p3900 or p0340 when commissioning has been completed.
Sets the proportional gain of the current model controller. This value is automatically preset using p3900 or p0340 when commissioning has been completed.
Sets the signal source for the excitation current actual value
Displays the excitation current actual value that is read in.

descriere_scurta: Gain factor, minimum excitation current closed-loop control
descriere: Sets the gain factor for the minimum excitation current, closed-loop control. This is active if the excitation current is below 75% of p1642.

descriere_scurta: and r1648.3 are reset at the end of the delay time.
descriere: Displays the control word for the excitation equipment.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint torque-generating smoothing time minimum
descriere: Sets the minimum smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the torque-generating current components.

descriere_scurta: Curr. setpoint torque-gen. smoothing time field weakening range
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the torque-generating current components.
Setting for activating/deactivating the current setpoint filter.
Sets the current setpoint filter 1 as low pass (PT2) or as extended general 2nd-order filter.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 1 denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 1 (PT2, general filter).
Sets the denominator damping for current setpoint filter 1.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 1 numerator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 1 (general filter).
Sets the numerator damping for current setpoint filter 1.
Sets the current setpoint filter 2 as low pass (PT2) or as extended general 2nd-order filter.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 2 denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 2 (PT2, general filter).
Sets the denominator damping for current setpoint filter 2.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 2 numerator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 2 (general filter).
Sets the numerator damping for current setpoint filter 2.
Sets the scaling of the dynamic current controller pre-control for the torque/force-generating current component Isq.
Threshold for the setpoint - actual value tracking of the EMF pre-control of the Isq current controller.
Sets the integral-action time of the current controller.
Sets the scaling of the quadrature arm decoupling
Displays the quadrature-axis component of voltage setpoint Uq. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045

descriere_scurta: Gain resonance damping for encoderless closed loop control
descriere: Defines the gain of the controller for resonance damping for operation with encoderless vector control in the range that current is impressed.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed threshold stall detection
descriere: Sets the speed threshold value to detect a stalled motor. If the adaptation controller output exceeds the parameterized speed difference, then bit 11 in status word p1408 is set.

descriere_scurta: Motor model error threshold stall detection
descriere: Sets the fault threshold in order to detect a motor that has stalled. If the error signal (r1746) exceeds the parameterized error threshold, then bit 12 in status word p1408 is set.

descriere_scurta: Motor model lower changeover speed n_set -> n_act
descriere: Sets the lower speed for the transition "n_set -> n_act" in encoderless operation. This value is entered as a percentage referred to p1749.

descriere_scurta: Motor model upper changeover speed n_set -> n_act
descriere: Sets the upper speed for the transition "n_set -> n_act" in sensorless operation. This value is entered as a percentage of p1755.

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover speed hysteresis operation with encoder /
descriere: Sets the hysteresis for the changeover speed of the motor model for operation with speed encoder.
